title: Mid-Level Full Stack Developer

title: AEM Backend Developer - Senior
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AEM Backend Developer - Senior based in Turkey. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced backend developer to build and enhance enterprise-grade digital experiences using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of scalable web content management solutions that support large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment, you will leverage modern Java technologies and AEM best practices to deliver high-quality solutions. You will partner with cross-functional teams to create reliable, maintainable, and high-performing applications while contributing to continuous improvement and technical excellence. This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building impactful digital products. Design, develop, and maintain backend solutions using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Java technologies. Build and extend AEM components, services, integrations, and administrative functionality to meet business requirements. Develop and support Web Content Management (WCM) components and enterprise applications. Implement and maintain integrations using REST APIs and related web technologies. Work with AEM frameworks including JCR, Apache Sling, Apache Felix, and OSGi to deliver scalable solutions. Manage project dependencies and builds using Maven and AEM Maven archetypes. Collaborate with frontend developers and other technical teams to deliver seamless end-to-end digital experiences. Troubleshoot technical issues, optimize application performance, and ensure code quality through best development practices. Contribute to architecture discussions, technical documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced AEM backend developer with strong Java expertise, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within distributed teams. Professional software development experience with a strong focus on Java. Solid hands-on experience working with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Strong understanding of AEM architecture and core building blocks. Experience extending AEM functionality and working with administrative features. Expertise in developing WCM components, custom integrations, and enterprise applications. Practical knowledge of JCR, Apache Sling, Apache Felix, OSGi, REST, JavaScript, and JSON. Experience using Maven and familiarity with AEM Maven archetypes. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AJAX. Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English communication skills. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and collaborative mindset. Benefits Remote work opportunity within Turkey. Competitive salary based on skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Comprehensive employee benefits package. Opportunity to work on innovative digital transformation projects with global clients. Collaborative, diverse, and inclusive work environment. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Exposure to modern AI-driven technologies and enterprise-scale digital platforms.
